An urban dweller living solo
who wants to manage their home efficiently

options.title: LG Sound Suite
options.desc:
Less adjusting, more enjoying.
Enjoy your favorite content with immersive sound.

After a long day, 
unwind at home with your favorite content.

LG Sound Suite uses Dolby Atmos FlexConnect,
developed with Dolby, to automatically adjust
the speakers and sound to suit your space
and content, so you can simply sit back
and enjoy a more immersive experience.

Experience premium sound
made for your personal time.

options.title: LG StanbyME 2 Max
options.desc:
One screen, wherever you need it.
Enjoy your favorite content anywhere at home.

In urban living,
one space often needs to work
for both work and relaxation.

LG StanbyME 2 Max features a 32-inch large screen
that can be used on a wall, table, or dedicated stand,
giving you the flexibility to enjoy your screen
wherever you need it.

Experience one flexible screen
that fits your space and lifestyle.

options.title: LG UltraGear
options.desc:
Less waiting, more playing.
Make even a quick gaming break more rewarding.

When gaming time is limited after a busy day,
fast response and smooth motion
make every moment count.

LG UltraGear delivers a native 1000Hz refresh rate 
while maintaining FHD resolution, showing 
fast-moving scenes and targets with greater 
clarity,so you can react faster and get fully
immersed even in a short gaming session.

Experience speed and clarity that help you 
get more out of every gaming moment.

and help reduce energy, water, and time
spent on everyday tasks.
